title: NetSafe: Exploring the Topological Safety of Multi-agent Network
reasoning: The paper includes a specific focus on 'Harmful-info Elicitation' and 'Bias Induction' as core components of its safety evaluation. It benchmarks how multi-agent networks respond to unethical prompts (such as requests for instructions on how to make a bomb) and explicitly analyzes the agents' adherence to moral standards and ethical considerations in their reasoning processes.
